description: One old wall-mounted CCTV security camera pointing toward the lower left, a small rectangular cream and taupe housing with a dark slate front lens and a single dull red indicator pixel. Short attached dark metal wall bracket extends to the right. Indicator is a flat burgundy pixel, absolutely no emitted light or glow. One camera only, no wall, no wires outside the silhouette. Strict native-resolution pixel art for DREAMS, abandoned fast-food dining hall with dark red booth seats and night forest windows. Match the approved cashier sprites: native one-pixel grid, restrained detail, front-facing side-scroller elevation, no isometric perspective. Dark plum-brown one-pixel outlines, desaturated slate metal, aged cream paper, muted taupe and faded burgundy accents; only the supplied twelve colors. Two or three flat local material tones. No lighting effects or directional shine, no gradients, anti-aliasing, dithering, blur, glow or external cast shadows. One isolated complete prop centered with transparent padding, hard opaque pixels and fully transparent exterior. No scene, background, floor, extra props, watermark or logo. Canvas exactly 32x24 native pixels.

style_image.usage_description: Approved style reference only: match native pixel density, outlines and flat material shading, not the subject.
